purpose_context: The Quadrano talk on Thu 19 Nov needs a real website whose data layer Quadrano can validate on stage. This mission builds a small static shop with its own GTM container, buttons that push correct and deliberately broken add_to_cart and purchase events, and a scenario switcher that walks the demo script, so the audience sees Quadrano's Console verdicts on genuine pushes. It must be demoable by Sun 8 Nov and run clean in three rehearsals by Thu 19 Nov.
purpose_tldr: A static mini-shop at demo.quadrano.com whose correct and deliberately broken data layer pushes let the Quadrano talk show live validation.
